verdict.rationale: SavvyCal's own docs describe round-robin distribution of meetings across a pool of organizers, aimed at sales teams. Each host can be given a priority, and two modes are offered: optimize for availability, or optimize for evenness to keep distribution equal. Per-host meeting limits on a link add further fairness control. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, and detail on true numeric weighting beyond per-host priority.

support.subject: As a sales lead, inbound meetings distribute across my team round-robin, with weighting or priority so load stays fair

citations.quote: Distribute meetings across a pool of organizers. Perfect for sales and customer support.
Each host in the rotation can have a priority, their own hours for the link, and their own meeting location, and meeting limits on the link count separately for each host.
Optimize for evenness gives each booking to the next person in line, and shows only their times.
Automatically distribute meetings across team members fairly.
